C0049.title: Douyin Enforces New Rules to Crack Down on "Main and Sub-Account" Traffic Manipulation, Banning Multiple Million-Follower Accounts
C0049.summary: Douyin's governance notice states that black and gray market organizations may use multiple sub-accounts for repetitive low-quality posts, fake followers and likes, and high-frequency interactions to funnel traffic to main accounts for improper profit. After issuing rules for improper matrix-account behavior, the platform said it would apply unified penalties to matrix accounts involved in improper profiteering, focusing on batch sub-account cheating, fake engagement, and improper traffic diversion.
